categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: intelligent manufacturing equipment and new energy vehicle motor and electronic control components. Intelligent equipment includes battery intelligent equipment, powertrain intelligent equipment, and body intelligent connection equipment. The new energy vehicle segment focuses on electric drive motors, motor controllers, onboard power supplies, and integrated electric drive systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as AI-driven virtual debugging, digital twin, machine vision, and laser welding in intelligent equipment. For new energy vehicle components, it focuses on high power density, low noise, lightweight design, and integration of SiC-based high-voltage electric drive technology. Production methods include customized non-standard equipment manufacturing for intelligent equipment and make-to-order production for standardized motor and control components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global and domestic automotive manufacturers such as Tesla, Volkswagen, BMW, Volvo, NIO, Chery Jaguar Land Rover, and battery manufacturers like CATL and BYD. The company serves the automotive industry, particularly in intelligent manufacturing and new energy vehicles, targeting both domestic and international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters in Hefei, Anhui Province, and has established subsidiaries in Germany, the UK, the USA, Japan, and Hong Kong. Its international business includes direct sales and services to global automotive brands, with overseas subsidiaries supporting local operations and project delivery.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the automotive supply chain, providing intelligent manufacturing equipment and core electric drive components to automotive OEMs and battery manufacturers. It is positioned as a key equipment and component supplier enabling automotive production and assembly.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing AI integration, digital twin technology, and industrial internet in intelligent equipment, and developing high-efficiency, integrated electric drive systems with SiC technology for new energy vehicles. The company emphasizes open collaborative R&D with customers and academic institutions, focusing on multi-disciplinary innovation and platform-based product development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of intelligent manufacturing equipment and new energy vehicle motor and control components. Intelligent equipment sales are project-based via bidding and contracts, while motor and control components are sold through volume supply agreements with OEMs. Additional revenue comes from government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in intelligent manufacturing equipment and new energy vehicle motor control components, competing with international and joint venture companies in China. It holds a strong market position supported by technological innovation, extensive customer base, and growing international presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 3.52 billion, a slight decline of 4.54% year-over-year, but achieved a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 21.3 million, turning profitable after previous losses. Total assets reached about RMB 7.6 billion, with steady growth in asset base and improved cash flow from operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, high-reliability, and high-flexibility intelligent manufacturing solutions tailored to customer needs, combined with advanced electric drive technologies offering high power density, efficiency, and integration. Its dual business model synergizes equipment and component expertise, providing comprehensive solutions that support automotive electrification and intelligent manufacturing transformation.
